name: tollgate-video
description: The Tollgate launch video, made with Remotion. See README.md.

scripts.render: npm run render:frames && npm run encode:mp4 && npm run encode:webp
scripts.encode:mp4: remotion ffmpeg -framerate 60 -i out/launch-frames/element-%04d.png -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -y out/tollgate.mp4
